spec.description: Lean host view for tasco-logserver-prod: CPU, memory, load, filesystem headroom (watermark-aligned), disk I/O, and network. Fed by node_exporter. Container-level metrics (cAdvisor) are a later phase.
Used % for every real filesystem, aligned to OpenSearch watermarks (80/85/95). Covers /, /data/opensearch, /data/gl-journal, /data/mongodb, /data/opensearch-snapshots.
spec.title: Filesystem Usage by Mount

spec.description: External NIC (ens3) throughput in bits/s. This is where firewall syslog arrives and admin/UI traffic flows.
spec.title: Network Traffic (ens3)

spec.description: Memory used % (based on MemAvailable). Host has 32 GB; OpenSearch heap is locked at 10 GB.
spec.title: Memory Used %

spec.description: Root filesystem (vDisk 0, 80 GB) used %. Holds OS, Docker, and app root.
spec.title: Root FS Used %

spec.description: CPU time by mode (user, system, iowait, etc.), averaged across cores.
spec.title: CPU by Mode

spec.description: Memory breakdown (used / cached / buffers / free), stacked.
spec.title: Memory Breakdown

spec.description: Load average vs vCPU count (8). Load sustained above vCPU count = CPU saturation.
spec.title: Load Average

spec.description: Disk throughput per block device. Writes shown below the axis.
spec.title: Disk I/O

spec.description: Disk busy % (fraction of time the device was servicing I/O). Sustained near 100% = disk saturation.
spec.title: Disk Busy %
